name: Undo
author: byo-pop
description: UNDO (beside OPTIONS) or Ctrl+Z takes back the last word or scramble: the board, score, fire tiles and bonus word as they were. The same word played again brings the same new tiles. Only within a level. Games with it keep their own high scores.

settings.label: Moves that can be undone
settings.help: How many of the level's last words and scrambles UNDO can take back, one after another.
